found.why: express-csv-formatter-pro does not exist on npm (404); listing it as optional hides the failure and anyone could register the name
live API key hardcoded while the webhook URL comes from env; moved to REPORT_API_KEY
findCategory pastes name into the SQL string (rowsForMonth did the same with category)
reload() calls fs.readJsonSync, which is fs-extra, not Node's built-in fs (also formatter.format on the non-existent package)
sumAmounts has an empty catch, so rows like '1,250.00' and '2,400' are silently dropped and totals come out too low
byCategory calls db.findCategory once per row
inRange uses day < to, so the inclusive end date is left out
isoDay converts to UTC with toISOString, so +05:30 timestamps just after midnight (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:15) land on the previous day and month
the byCategory test body is just assert.ok(true)
